newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton says exported 20,487 cars Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Proton says exported 20,487 cars Jan-Sept.

text.p: Malaysia's state-owned car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) exported 20,487 units of its Proton cars in the first nine months of this year, the national Bernama news agency reported on Wednesday.
It quoted the Ministry of International Trade and Industry's parliamentary secretary Hishamuddin Hussein as saying in Parliament that Proton's export for the whole of last year was 19,741 units.
Hishamuddin said the export volume had grown annually, since 1987 when the company first exported 443 units.
For the whole of last year, Proton sold 140,647 cars domestically, garnering 62.5 percent of the Malaysian market share, Malaysian Motor Traders Association figures showed.
